BL10435E: Detail of a bas relief depicting Cupid and Psyche in the billiard room at Tring Park. The sculptor was George Adolphus Storey. The image was taken for Lord de Rothschild.

September 1890, Bedford Lemere and Company.

To search for more images like this, and over 1 million catalogue records, visit the Historic England Archive website: [https://archive.historicengland.org.uk](http://archive.historicengland.org.uk)
